headline: BMO Capital Markets kept Google's parent Alphabet as a top pick after it launched Gemini Agent, an AI helper for office work, says a weekly roundup of analyst moves on AI stocks.
score_reason: Pool score 5 lowered by 1: the Gemini Agent launch was on 8 Oct 2026 and BMO's note was reported on 9 Oct, before the window; the roundup is broker opinion.
importance_line: What changed is that a major bank's analysts say the enterprise-agent launch eases fears that Alphabet is falling behind in AI, which matters first to savers whose funds hold Alphabet, then to rival AI-agent makers such as Meta and OpenAI, and the doubt is that these are broker opinions, not results.
summary: Investing.com reports that BMO Capital Markets reiterated an Outperform rating on Alphabet and kept it as a top pick after the launch of Gemini Agent, which our 9 Oct 2026 edition carried, citing a 98% fall since 2024 in the cost per token (the small units of text AI models are billed by). The roundup also lists Citi's preferred chip stocks, price-target increases for Marvell after its analyst day, Citi's downgrade of NXP and Truist's start of coverage of IBM at Hold.
notes: Investing.com page blocked (HTTP 403); full text read on Yahoo Finance (finance.yahoo.com/technology/ai/articles/5-big-analyst-ai-moves-215722392.html), which republishes it under the Investing.com byline, so Investing.com is the source and the link is its original. Older news re-dated: Gemini Agent was carried in our 9 Oct 2026 edition (item 52).
